title: J3: Chat.mimiRoomUri and Chat.fixedMembership properties
description: JMAP has no field for the MIMI room URI and cannot tell a Group DM (fixed membership, >2 users) from a group. Recommended: read-only extension properties Chat.mimiRoomUri and Chat.fixedMembership. PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.12 is planned.
notes:
2026-10-18: the mimiRoomUri part is superseded by draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00's Chat.roomId (jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7); fixedMembership remains open.
DECIDED: provider side: Chat.roomId (mimi-00) replaces mimiRoomUri; no fixedMembership property (mimi-00 L236: clients take name/participants from MLS group state). Agent side: a room-policy-04 fixed_membership room with 2 participants maps to kind 'direct' with contactId = the other user's URI; every other room is 'group'. Creating a direct Chat on the agent creates a fixed_membership 2-participant room. Add/remove in a fixed-membership group gets 'forbidden'. The hub still enforces policy.
